in_hebrew.name: Alpheus
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Friend of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Alpheus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Ἀλφεῖος (Alpheios), which means 'friend of God'. In Greek mythology, Alpheus was a river god who was said to be the father of the goddess Aphrodite.
